about.storyImageAlt: Yassine Anflousse, founder of Movie Cam
about.storyLead: Yassine Anflousse is a young filmmaker and entrepreneur who founded Movie Cam in 2023 in Agadir, Morocco. Driven by his passion for filmmaking, he created Movie Cam to help filmmakers and beginners find professional equipment and bring their creative ideas to life.

about.storyBody: Yassine Anflousse is a young filmmaker and entrepreneur who founded Movie Cam in 2023 in Agadir, Morocco. Driven by his passion for filmmaking, he created Movie Cam to help filmmakers and beginners find professional equipment and bring their creative ideas to life. Our mission is to turn passion into reality.
